sourceGroup: Nine bounded follow-up findings; successor source/image identity not yet supplied to this triage. Frozen d5dd remains separate.
preconditions: After source qualification, record the exact new full commit, root/apps-web/src trees, verified archive SHA and deployed image digest/build receipt. Verify the staging origin serves that exact image; no inherited d5dd test/image acceptance transferred.

Read and record actual deployed Core/Strategy/Workspace versions and required schema/feature state. The inspected compatibility pin is243248e726243c44bd4b9d24fd1ed220da18c56a; no assumption that this version or its migrations is live. Use documented full service prefixes with approved existing origins, never guessed URLs.

Use pre-provisioned disposable test tenant T and isolated tenant U; current actors with normal read/write role, read-only role, explicit no-client/no-task access and separate actor. Verify actual native role and current tenant membership. Do not assign roles or change grants merely to create a test without explicit owner approval.

Keep client A/B, prospect, two Planner tasks, Strategy node, Workspace draft, signatures and two expendable files in a signed owner inventory. Prefer existing known fixtures for all read-first checks. No production/customer records or protected text in screenshots/logs.

Use Clerk designated capiro JWT and current org/client boundary through existing app transports. Do not export tokens, presigned URLs or full sensitive payloads. Capture request method/path/status, redacted scope IDs, relevant safe fields and image/source identity only.

Admin-only setup is separate from runtime read checks. GET /tenant-members has no endpoint admin requirement at inspected source; global current session/tenant membership still required. Core Engagement controller has standard_user RolesGuard, Planner and Workspace retain their native ACLs.

Keep provider email send/calendar sync/bot/attachment extraction/generation disabled or uninvoked. Open/review/search/read-only checks need no send. CR-11 paid native rewrite and CP-03 destructive storage deletion are separate explicit approvals, with finite call budget and stop-on-uncertainty.

Existing release manifest migration/native database/RLS/privilege requirements remain owner prerequisites; this triage neither applies nor claims them. Browser read flows may cause routine auth/audit bookkeeping; use already provisioned identities and do not mislabel read-only UI as literally zero server bookkeeping.

optionalSetupContracts.purpose: Signature setup only if no pre-provisioned actor
optionalSetupContracts.receipt: html nullable/enabled; sanitize at native owner
optionalSetupContracts.approval: Separate disposable-account settings mutation; retain previous state for authorized restore. No mail send.

optionalSetupContracts.purpose: Planner test tasks only if no known fixtures
optionalSetupContracts.input: Existing {data}; update uses current version. Two finite task records; no imported command or Engagement task fallback.
optionalSetupContracts.approval: Separate disposable task setup approval; version conflict/uncertainty stops, no blind replay.
Use existing reviewed fixture inventory/owner procedures. This triage does not invent seeding routes or authorize upload, generate, member grants or arbitrary deletion.

checks.setup: Pre-provisioned readable client A, readable client B and known denied client; current verified actor/tenant.
steps: Visit /modules/calendar?clientId=A and capture verified selected-client state and actual Core meeting query.
Switch Month/Week/Agenda once each without scope loss; select Master then B.
Attempt known denied/stale client hint using authorized test account; verify refusal/unavailable selection and no fallback that presents it as authorized.
checks.pass: Only current verified selected scope is shown/queried; actor/org replacement drops old data.
checks.finiteLimit: Three view transitions; two explicit scope changes; one denied hint. No record writes.

checks.setup: Two existing readable Planner tasks in bounded visible range: one distinct start/due, one same-day start/due or start-only; recorded timezone/date values.
steps: Open Master Agenda and Planner filter; compare occurrences to canonical planner.tasks payload.
Inspect distinct start/due date/time/zone and same-occurrence deduplication; verify task identity attached to each occurrence.
checks.pass: Both distinct dates retained; no fabricated timestamp/UTC-midnight or missing start.
checks.finiteLimit: Two known tasks, one week/range; fixture dataset under one native Planner page. Do not page whole tenant unnecessarily.

checks.setup: Existing Planner task plus native permitted Planner read; either a pre-provisioned role with actual meeting refusal or separately authorized client-side one-request failure interception.
steps: Open Master Agenda with one meetings403/503 while Planner succeeds.
Verify source warning plus visible Planner occurrence and working source/search filters.
Remove read fault or use restored read access once and verify no stale denied data appears.
checks.pass: One failed source does not remove other successful authorized feeds.
checks.finiteLimit: One failed meeting response and one subsequent successful read; no native role mutation to induce it.
checks.evidenceLimit: Client-side intercepted error is synthetic resilience evidence against native successful feeds, not proof the server actually returned403. Label separately.

checks.setup: Known readable task outside current My tasks/page plus one known denied/nonexistent task ID supplied by staging owner.
steps: Click the Agenda occurrence and verify exact task ID via planner.task GET and displayed record.
Open denied/unavailable task link and verify unavailable state, no cached/alternate task or write.
checks.pass: Exact authorized task opened; current owner access respected outside list-page filtering.
checks.finiteLimit: Two task IDs, one open each; no status/comment/editor save.

checks.setup: Dedicated actor with pre-existing safe formatted signature and actor without signature; mailbox/read policy already provisioned. Use controlled non-delivering draft.
steps: Open composer and review; compare visible signature to native GET html/enabled without sending.
Toggle append locally; inspect disabled/absent state and switch actor/client to confirm no stale signature.
Use offline malicious HTML/remote-resource fixtures for execution/resource suppression; do not store attack markup in shared native user data.
checks.pass: Signature is inspectable, policy-consistent, safe and current; no mail send/upload/rewrite request.
checks.finiteLimit: Two provisioned actors; one draft each; no provider POST.

checks.setup: For source closure use controlled verified rewrite response in isolated harness. Optional native run requires separately approved governed outreach_generate/LLM capability, disposable draft, bounded provider budget and non-sensitive text.
steps: Submit one rewrite (fixture first; native only if separately approved), verify resulting body, then Undo and verify exact prior body locally.
Verify Undo dispatch count stays zero; cancelled/stale/unverified result and actor replacement cannot restore another draft.
checks.pass: Verified rewrite can be undone without another request; provenance/authority/pending protections retained.
checks.finiteLimit: Zero native calls by default. Optional approved native run: at most one rewrite POST, zero retry, zero mail send.

checks.setup: One readable Strategy node and Workspace draft with known owner clerkUserId in native active tenant-members; one unassigned/unresolved owner record already prepared.
steps: Compare native strategies/detail, Workspace slim draft list, and settings.tenantMembers records; exact clerkUserId lookup only.
Inspect node owner/status and document owner; deny/fail roster read once with controlled read interception or pre-provisioned role; verify unresolved state rather than wrong name or Unassigned.
Switch to client B / actor B and verify prior owner/draft data is absent until current authorized reads succeed.
checks.pass: Current authorized identity or truthful unresolved/unassigned state; independent source errors and legacy client-name safeguards preserved.
checks.finiteLimit: Two known work records, one roster refusal, one scope change; no strategy/draft/membership writes.

checks.setup: Two existing authorized files in one disposable/readable prospect with distinctive names and one different denied prospect; records may include blocked readiness.
steps: Read native exact prospect list; search mixed-case match, no match, then clear.
Confirm list actions/readiness apply only to filtered current records; changing prospect/actor or denied fresh read clears stale names/results.
checks.pass: Search affects loaded authorized collection only and clear restores that collection; no invented hidden corpus completeness.
checks.finiteLimit: One list, three local search states, one context replacement. No preview/download/upload/delete/research generation.

checks.setup: Owner-approved disposable tenant/client and uploader/editor account; two known disposable attachment IDs whose entire object/index/content retention can be destroyed; existing read-only/no-access accounts. Real storage delete is unavoidable in this test and requires explicit authorization.
steps: Read both current scoped file records and record non-sensitive IDs/lifecycle; confirm intended disposable object ownership.
DELETE first file once and verify valid receipt plus fresh scoped read; capture native lifecycle/current absence separately from physical storage/index erasure.

For second file, permit exactly one DELETE dispatch then suppress/drop only its response through an approved client-side fault control; verify uncertainty survives dialog reopen and no automatic repeat.

Perform explicit fresh GET reconciliation; current absence is not operation causality. If record remains pending/failed, preserve state. A deliberate same-ID retry is allowed only under a separate owner-approved recovery branch and current native authority; no new ID or fallback delete.
Use already denied/read-only role for read/control refusal; do not revoke real grants or probe arbitrary foreign IDs.
checks.pass: Uncertain completion is explicit; no blind automatic DELETE; scoped readback and any deliberate recovery preserve identity and authority. Native storage/lifecycle evidence reported separately.
checks.finiteLimit: Default approved branch two DELETE dispatches total (one per disposable file), two initial/readback collections. Optional deliberate retry at most one additional same-ID DELETE only when native record remains and owner explicitly approves; otherwise stop.
checks.providerBoundary: This deletion reaches S3 through the existing Core owner; no direct AWS call. Cannot claim zero storage effects. Suppress unrelated mail/calendar/LLM/webhook/ingestion actions and use staging objects only.

acceptanceRecording: Record each check as native pass/fail/unrun or mixed synthetic/native with exact scope. A read-only pass cannot accept mutation/provider facets; local source repair cannot close full row. Leave all337 original statuses unchanged until the separately authorized row-specific acceptance process.
